In [[44 ABY]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sullustan inmate''' resided in the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]]. He, along with several other prisoners led by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] thief [[Furan]], confronted former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahiri Veila]], but was soundly beaten.
